top_choice_rationale: The quantum spin Hall effect offers a specific, mature prediction-to-realization achievement with a clear boundary from later topological-insulator work. Its three proposed contributors have broad support, though the experimental attribution merits historical review.
recusal_note: My WACQT leadership and Chalmers work create professional proximity to superconducting-circuit research, but no listed proposal concerns that work; no direct connection to the proposed laureates is apparent from my profile.
